readme:
# π0 反向时间流与动作积分

## 1. 问题

π0 反向时间流与动作积分：实现下列接口并通过数值、边界和实验检查。

提取官方openpi的线性流路径和Euler采样方向；显式给定噪声与时间，用线性速度回归替代VLA动作专家。

## 2. 核心公式

$$
x_t=t\epsilon+(1-t)a,\quad u=\epsilon-a,\quad x_{t+\Delta t}=x_t+\Delta t\,v_t,\quad \Delta t\le0.
$$

## 3. 公式到代码

- `flow_interpolate(actions: Tensor, noise: Tensor, time: Tensor) -> tuple`
- `euler_step(state: Tensor, velocity: Tensor, dt: float) -> Tensor`

官方代码的时间方向是动作到噪声，速度标签为noise-actions。采样时负步长把噪声拉回动作；不能同时翻转标签和遗漏负步长。detach仅针对监督标签，不针对混合状态。

## 4. 本题约定

action/noise为(B,H,D)，time为(B,)且在[0,1]。返回混合状态和detach的速度标签；状态保留梯度。Euler输入同形，dt有限且<=0。t=1为噪声，采样走向t=0。

校验辅助函数已提供。浮点输入为有限 CPU float32/float64，不修改输入；非法形状、类型、范围或掩码必须抛出 `ValueError`。

## 5. 交互图与确定性实验

`experiment.py` 在固定输入上调用提交的全部接口，记录学习或采样曲线与末端指标。实验逻辑和阈值见 T3，输出同样用于可视化。

可视化由 `viz/gen.py` 生成；T3 将你的函数传入同一实验并记录真实指标。这是小规模确定性教学实验，不是机器人基准成绩。

## 6. 在网页中运行

在右侧 Python 编辑器中补全实现，点击 **运行测试**。查看失败测试的原因、期望值与实际值，修改代码后再次运行。所有必要测试通过后，题目会标记为已完成并解锁坑点讲解。

## 7. 来源与延伸

- [π₀: A Vision-Language-Action Flow Model for General Robot Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.24164) — Official openpi Pi0.compute_loss and sample_actions time orientation
- [Verified source](https://github.com/Physical-Intelligence/openpi/blob/main/src/openpi/models/pi0.py)

核验日期：2026-10-28。扩展到完整论文系统还需要本题范围中明确省略的模型、数据和环境。

## 测试捕获的错误

- Flow labels use the opposite time direction.
- Reverse-time Euler changes the sign twice.

## 实验范围

提取官方openpi的线性流路径和Euler采样方向；显式给定噪声与时间，用线性速度回归替代VLA动作专家。

## 可重复实验记录

6×2×1动作块，噪声取负动作，6个等间隔时间；标量速度增益从0开始60步梯度下降(lr=0.5)，再以dt=-0.1积分10步。要求速度MSE<初始1e-10且采样MSE<1e-10。

判题固定seed=42。计算采用CPU float64、显式输入，涉及优化时使用普通梯度更新；不下载数据集或模型权重。原生PyTorch与真实Pyodide/NumPy-WASM执行同一套T0–T3测试。阈值针对本教学实验。

en.readme:
# π0 Reverse-Time Action Flow

## 1. Exercise goal

π0 Reverse-Time Action Flow: implement the interfaces below and verify numerical, boundary and experimental behavior.

Isolate the official openpi linear flow path and Euler sampling direction; explicit noise/time and a linear velocity regressor replace the VLA action expert.

## 2. Core equations

$$
x_t=t\epsilon+(1-t)a,\quad u=\epsilon-a,\quad x_{t+\Delta t}=x_t+\Delta t\,v_t,\quad \Delta t\le0.
$$

## 3. From equations to code

- `flow_interpolate(actions: Tensor, noise: Tensor, time: Tensor) -> tuple`
- `euler_step(state: Tensor, velocity: Tensor, dt: float) -> Tensor`

Official code parameterizes time from actions to noise, so the target velocity is noise-actions. Negative sampling steps transport noise back to actions. Detach the supervised label, not the interpolated state.

## 4. Contract and boundaries

Actions/noise are (B,H,D), time (B,) in [0,1]. Return interpolated state and detached velocity target; retain state gradients. Euler inputs match shapes, dt is finite and <=0. Noise is t=1 and sampling moves to t=0.

Validation helpers are provided. All floating inputs are finite CPU float32/float64; do not mutate inputs. Invalid shape, dtype, range or mask arguments raise `ValueError`.

## 5. Deterministic experiment and visualization

`experiment.py` calls every submitted interface on fixed inputs and records a learning or sampling curve and terminal metrics. T3 states the behavioral thresholds; the visualization uses the same outputs.

The visualization is generated by `viz/gen.py`; T3 runs the same experiment with your functions and records its actual metrics. These are small deterministic teaching results, not a robot benchmark.

## 6. Run your implementation

Complete the functions in the Python editor on the right, then click **Run tests**. Inspect each failed check, update your implementation, and run again. Passing every required check marks the problem as solved and unlocks the notes.

## 7. Sources and extensions

- [π₀: A Vision-Language-Action Flow Model for General Robot Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.24164) — Official openpi Pi0.compute_loss and sample_actions time orientation
- [Verified source](https://github.com/Physical-Intelligence/openpi/blob/main/src/openpi/models/pi0.py)

Verified 2026-10-28. Extending this operator to the full paper requires the omitted model, data and environment described in the scope above.
en.notes:
# π₀: Solution notes

Official code parameterizes time from actions to noise, so the target velocity is noise-actions. Negative sampling steps transport noise back to actions. Detach the supervised label, not the interpolated state.

Identify reduction axes, validity masks and gradient paths from the equations before comparing a small hand calculation. Test oracles do not call the reference implementation.

## Mistakes caught by the tests

- Flow labels use the opposite time direction.
- Reverse-time Euler changes the sign twice.

## Experimental scope

Isolate the official openpi linear flow path and Euler sampling direction; explicit noise/time and a linear velocity regressor replace the VLA action expert.

## Reproducible protocol

A 6×2×1 action block, noise equal to negative actions, six evenly spaced times; fit a zero-initialized scalar velocity gain for 60 gradient steps at lr .5, then integrate ten steps at dt -.1. Require velocity MSE below 1e-10 of initial and sample MSE below 1e-10.

The judge fixes seed 42. All calculations use CPU float64, explicit inputs and plain gradient updates where applicable; no datasets or model weights are downloaded. Native PyTorch and actual Pyodide/NumPy-WASM run the same T0–T3 suite. Thresholds refer to this teaching adaptation.
